title: Question about the prom scene in Carrie

commenti.body: Her eye focus is clearly on each act she performs. The director shows her stare at something before it happens. She’s never in a trance. She’s super pissed the fuck off. Rewatch and notice how her eyes control each action in the death scene. Carrie was a simple girl, sheltered from life by an abusive mother. Prom was so special and important for her. A moment to be beheld as a woman. Once the prank occurs, Carrie is royally pissed the fuck off.
